response.overview: A Sun In the Palm is an experimental art film - an abstract, atmospheric and deep journey into connection through sound and moving image, filmed in Cairo, Sinai, Upper Egypt (EGY), Île-de-France (FR) and the Dalarna region (SW).  The film is divided in 5 acts, each showcasing the authentic practices of the five protagonists that build the narration, embodying one different perspective on connection: to God and the body, to nature and the soft heart of life, to the self through beauty, to others through love, conflict, acceptance and gentleness and to the things of the world through empathy and unity. It is a narrative, abstract and spiritual elaboration, it aims to engage emotionally, hoping to leave the viewer with questions that can remain un-answered.
response.title: A Sun In The Palm
